msg: The gnomes are split into 2 groups. The Orange, Yellow, Blue and Green gnomes take you to the yellow wood and the pink, purple, brown and red ones will take you to the purple woods. Group 1 (O,Y, B, G) start giving you the higher amont of mushrooms, about half way though, it will being to swtich and then group 2 (P,P,B,R) will give you the highet yeild. It resets between each break. Once you start to notice that the woods you are going to start to yeild less mushrooms then test the other group.  If you imagin that it is a 2 line graph and as one line goes down, the other goes up, then they will switch.  Stay focused and dont forgot to hit the space bar when you are in the woods. Stay focused and good luck! :)
